name: Sara Putnam
source:
"You'd better work hard, so you don't tarnish Wordsworth's name."

A hard-working but shrewd student. She is best friends with [url=/c94022]Abigail[/url], the resident advisor. Known for being stern and protective, she frequently admonishes Abigail for being too lenient on the other students, but the two are incredibly close.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=cera]official page[/url]]
